chapterInfo.content:
16
Dawid aseda ne ayeyie dwom
1 # 2 Sa 6.17-19 Na wɔde Nyankopɔn adaka no baa mu, de bɛsii ntomadan a Dawid asi ama no no mu, na wɔbobɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ Nyankopɔn anim. 2Na Dawid wiee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no bɔ no, ɔde AWURADE din hyiraa ɔman no. 3Na ɔkyekyɛɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa, mmarima ne mmaa, obiara, paanoo mua ne nankum ne bobe aba taterɛ.
4Na ɔyeyɛɛ Lewifoɔ no mu bi asomfoɔ wɔ AWURADE adaka no anim, sɛ wɔnkamfo AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn nna no ase nyi no ayɛ. 5Asaf ne panin, na Sakaria di hɔ, Yeiel ne Semiramot ne Yehiel ne Matitia ne Eliab ne Benaia ne Obed-Edom ne Yeiel, wɔkurakura mmɛnta ne nsankutene, na Asaf deɛ, ɔbɔ nnawuro a ɛgyegyeɛ. 6Na Benaia ne Yahasiel, asɔfoɔ no hyɛnee ntotorobɛnto daa daa Nyankopɔn apam adaka no anim.
7Da no ara na Dawid maa wɔfaa Asaf ne ne nuanom so daa AWURADE ase kane.
8 # Dwom 105.1-15 O monna AWURADE ase, mommɔ ne din,
momma wɔnhunu ne nneyɛɛ aman mu.
9Monto no dwom, monto no ayeyie dwom,
monka n’anwanwadeɛ nyinaa.
10Momfa ne din kronkron nhyehye mo ho,
ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ AWURADE akoma ntɔ wɔn yam.
11Mompɛ AWURADE ne ne tumi akyiri kwan,
monhwehwɛ n’anim daa daa.
12Monkae n’anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ,
n’ahodwirideɛ ne n’anomu atemmusɛm.
13O ne somfoɔ Abraham asefoɔ,
Yakob a ɔfaa no no mma.
14Ɔno ne AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn,
n’atemmudeɛ wɔ asase nyinaa so.
15Wɔnkae n’apam no nkɔsi daa,
asɛm a ɔhyɛɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ apem no,
16sɛdeɛ ɔne Abraham pameeɛ no
ne ne ntam a ɔkaa Isak no.
17Na ɔde sii hɔ maa Yakob sɛ ahyɛdeɛ,
ne Israel sɛ daa apam
18kaa sɛ: Wo na mede Kanaan asase bɛma woɔ,
sɛ wo agyapadeɛ a wɔakyɛ no susuhoma soɔ.
19Berɛ a na wɔsua,
na wɔmmu wɔn ho akonta wɔ akyinkyinakyinkyin mu,
20na wɔnenam firi ɔman mu kɔ ɔman mu,
wɔfiri ahennie bi mu kɔ ɔman foforɔ bi mu no,
21 # Gye 12.17; 20.3; 26.9 wamma obi anhom wɔn so,
na wɔn nti ɔkaa ahemfo anim:
22Sɛ monnka wɔn a wɔasra wɔn no,
na monnyɛ m’adiyifoɔ bɔne biara.
23 # Dwom 96 Monto AWURADE dwom, asase nyinaa so!
Mompae ne nkwagyeɛ mfiri da nkɔ da mu.
24Monka n’animuonyam wiase aman mu,
ne n’anwanwadeɛ aman nyinaa mu.
25Na AWURADE yɛ ɔkɛseɛ na ɔsɛ ayeyie sɛ,
na ne ho yɛ hu anyame nyinaa mu.
26Na amanaman anyame nyinaa yɛ abosonhuhuo,
na AWURADE deɛ, ɔno na ɔyɛɛ ɔsoro.
27Anidie ne animuonyam wɔ n’anim,
tumi ne anika wɔ ne tenabea.
28 # Dwom 29.1-2 Aman mmusuakuo, momma AWURADE,
momma AWURADE animuonyam ne tumi.
29Momfa AWURADE din no animuonyam mma no,
monsoa ayɛyɛdeɛ mmra n’anim.
Monsɔre AWURADE wɔ ahokeka kronkron mu.
30Asase nyinaa, mo ho mpopo wɔ n’anim.
Wiase tim hɔ pintinn, ɛrenhinhim da.
31Wɔmma ɔsoro ani nnye, na asase ho nsane no;
wɔnka no amanaman mu sɛ: AWURADE adi hene.
32Ɛpo ne ne mayɛ bɛworo.
Mfofowa ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa bɛdi ahurisie.
33Ɛno na kwaeɛ mu nnua bɛto ahosan nnwom, AWURADE anim,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔreba abɛbu asase atɛn.
34 # Dwom 106.1, 47-48 Monna AWURADE ase, na ɔyɛ,
na n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
35Na monka sɛ:
Gye yɛn nkwa, yɛn nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn,
na boaboa yɛn ano, na yi yɛn firi amanaman mu,
na yɛnna wo din kronkron no ase,
na yɛmfa w’ayeyie nhyehyɛ yɛn ho.
36 # Dwom 41.13 Nhyira nka AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn,
firi daa kɔsi daa.
Na ɔman no nyinaa gyee so sɛ Amen, de yii AWURADE ayɛ.
Onyamesom no ho nsiesieeɛ
37Ɛnna ɔgyaa Asaf ne ne nuanom hɔ AWURADE apam adaka no anim, sɛ wɔnsom adaka no anim daa, sɛdeɛ ɛhia da biara; 38na Obed-Edom ne wɔn nuanom yɛ aduosia nwɔtwe, na Yedutun ba Obed-Edom ne Hosa yɛɛ apono ano ahwɛfoɔ. 39#1 Be 21.29 Na ɔgyaa Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne ne nuanom asɔfoɔ hɔ AWURADE tenabea no anim sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɛwɔ Gibea no, 40#Eks 29.38-39 sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no so, mma AWURADE daa daa anɔpa ne anwummerɛ nyɛ sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no AWURADE mmara a ɔhyɛɛ Israel no mu nyinaa. 41Na Heman ne Yedutun ka wɔn ho, ne wɔn a wɔyii wɔn a wɔbobɔɔ wɔn din no nkaeɛ, sɛ wɔnna AWURADE ase, sɛ n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa. 42Na Heman ne Yedutun ka wɔn ho kura ntotorobɛnto ne nsambɔ nnawuro a wɔma no gyegyeɛ, ne nnoɔma a wɔde to Nyankopɔn dwom. Na Yedutun mma deɛ, na wɔwɔ ɛpono ano.
43Ɛnna ɔman no nyinaa sii mu kɔɔ wɔn afie, na Dawid nso sane kɔ kɔhyiraa ne fiefoɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na wɔde Nyankopɔn adaka no baa mu, de bɛsii ntomadan a Dawid asi ama no no mu, na wɔbobɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ Nyankopɔn anim. Na Dawid wiee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no bɔ no, ɔde AWURADE din hyiraa ɔman no. Na ɔkyekyɛɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa, mmarima ne mmaa, obiara, paanoo mua ne nankum ne bobe aba taterɛ.
Na ɔyeyɛɛ Lewifoɔ no mu bi asomfoɔ wɔ AWURADE adaka no anim, sɛ wɔnkamfo AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn nna no ase nyi no ayɛ. Asaf ne panin, na Sakaria di hɔ, Yeiel ne Semiramot ne Yehiel ne Matitia ne Eliab ne Benaia ne Obed-Edom ne Yeiel, wɔkurakura mmɛnta ne nsankutene, na Asaf deɛ, ɔbɔ nnawuro a ɛgyegyeɛ. Na Benaia ne Yahasiel, asɔfoɔ no hyɛnee ntotorobɛnto daa daa Nyankopɔn apam adaka no anim.
Da no ara na Dawid maa wɔfaa Asaf ne ne nuanom so daa AWURADE ase kane.
O monna AWURADE ase, mommɔ ne din,
momma wɔnhunu ne nneyɛɛ aman mu.
Monto no dwom, monto no ayeyie dwom,
monka n’anwanwadeɛ nyinaa.
Momfa ne din kronkron nhyehye mo ho,
ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ AWURADE akoma ntɔ wɔn yam.
Mompɛ AWURADE ne ne tumi akyiri kwan,
monhwehwɛ n’anim daa daa.
Monkae n’anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ,
n’ahodwirideɛ ne n’anomu atemmusɛm.
O ne somfoɔ Abraham asefoɔ,
Yakob a ɔfaa no no mma.
Ɔno ne AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn,
n’atemmudeɛ wɔ asase nyinaa so.
Wɔnkae n’apam no nkɔsi daa,
asɛm a ɔhyɛɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ apem no,
sɛdeɛ ɔne Abraham pameeɛ no
ne ne ntam a ɔkaa Isak no.
Na ɔde sii hɔ maa Yakob sɛ ahyɛdeɛ,
ne Israel sɛ daa apam
kaa sɛ: Wo na mede Kanaan asase bɛma woɔ,
sɛ wo agyapadeɛ a wɔakyɛ no susuhoma soɔ.
Berɛ a na wɔsua,
na wɔmmu wɔn ho akonta wɔ akyinkyinakyinkyin mu,
na wɔnenam firi ɔman mu kɔ ɔman mu,
wɔfiri ahennie bi mu kɔ ɔman foforɔ bi mu no,
wamma obi anhom wɔn so,
na wɔn nti ɔkaa ahemfo anim:
Sɛ monnka wɔn a wɔasra wɔn no,
na monnyɛ m’adiyifoɔ bɔne biara.
Monto AWURADE dwom, asase nyinaa so!
Mompae ne nkwagyeɛ mfiri da nkɔ da mu.
Monka n’animuonyam wiase aman mu,
ne n’anwanwadeɛ aman nyinaa mu.
Na AWURADE yɛ ɔkɛseɛ na ɔsɛ ayeyie sɛ,
na ne ho yɛ hu anyame nyinaa mu.
Na amanaman anyame nyinaa yɛ abosonhuhuo,
na AWURADE deɛ, ɔno na ɔyɛɛ ɔsoro.
Anidie ne animuonyam wɔ n’anim,
tumi ne anika wɔ ne tenabea.
Aman mmusuakuo, momma AWURADE,
momma AWURADE animuonyam ne tumi.
Momfa AWURADE din no animuonyam mma no,
monsoa ayɛyɛdeɛ mmra n’anim.
Monsɔre AWURADE wɔ ahokeka kronkron mu.
Asase nyinaa, mo ho mpopo wɔ n’anim.
Wiase tim hɔ pintinn, ɛrenhinhim da.
Wɔmma ɔsoro ani nnye, na asase ho nsane no;

Ɛpo ne ne mayɛ bɛworo.
Mfofowa ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa bɛdi ahurisie.
Ɛno na kwaeɛ mu nnua bɛto ahosan nnwom, AWURADE anim,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔreba abɛbu asase atɛn.
Monna AWURADE ase, na ɔyɛ,
na n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
Na monka sɛ:
Gye yɛn nkwa, yɛn nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn,

Nhyira nka AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn,
firi daa kɔsi daa.
Na ɔman no nyinaa gyee so sɛ Amen, de yii AWURADE ayɛ.

Ɛnna ɔgyaa Asaf ne ne nuanom hɔ AWURADE apam adaka no anim, sɛ wɔnsom adaka no anim daa, sɛdeɛ ɛhia da biara; na Obed-Edom ne wɔn nuanom yɛ aduosia nwɔtwe, na Yedutun ba Obed-Edom ne Hosa yɛɛ apono ano ahwɛfoɔ. Na ɔgyaa Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne ne nuanom asɔfoɔ hɔ AWURADE tenabea no anim sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɛwɔ Gibea no, sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no so, mma AWURADE daa daa anɔpa ne anwummerɛ nyɛ sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no AWURADE mmara a ɔhyɛɛ Israel no mu nyinaa. Na Heman ne Yedutun ka wɔn ho kura ntotorobɛnto ne nsambɔ nnawuro a wɔma no gyegyeɛ, ne nnoɔma a wɔde to Nyankopɔn dwom. Na Yedutun mma deɛ, na wɔwɔ ɛpono ano.
Ɛnna ɔman no nyinaa sii mu kɔɔ wɔn afie, na Dawid nso sane kɔ kɔhyiraa ne fiefoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
